summary: First testing iteration for Autopilot Passive Income OS MVP. Backend: 26/26 tests passing (after running Coach class in isolation due to transient EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap when 3 large AI calls fired back-to-back). Frontend: critical flows (landing, register, sidebar nav across all 7 pages, streams CRUD + log income, dashboard metrics, simulator, goals upsert+persist, logout) all working. AI integrations (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) producing valid JSON for Ideas, Content, and multi-turn Coach memory. Stream creation, entry logging, and total_earned aggregation work end-to-end. data-testid coverage is excellent throughout the app.

minor.issue: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY hit a transient per-minute/per-key budget cap when ideas + content + coach were called back-to-back in the same pytest run (litellm error: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.031833, Max budget: 0.001'). Re-running the Coach tests in isolation 30s later passed cleanly. Code is correct; this is a budget/throttling characteristic of the shared key, not a bug. Recommend either: (a) spacing AI calls in test runner with sleeps, or (b) noting in user docs that very rapid consecutive AI calls may briefly throttle.

design_issues.screen: Dashboard (and any page rendering charts when chart container is briefly 0px during mount)
issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Cosmetic — charts render correctly after layout settles. Could be silenced by setting min-h-[200px] on ResponsiveContainer parent or wrapping with explicit aspect ratio. Not blocking.

action_items: Optional: silence Recharts width/height warnings by giving chart containers an explicit min-height (e.g. min-h-[260px]) on the parent wrapping <ResponsiveContainer>.

Optional: consider adding a small backoff/retry on 502 from /api/ai/* endpoints in the frontend (Ideas/Content/Coach pages) so transient EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget hits surface a friendlier message rather than a raw error.
Nothing is blocking. Backend & all critical user flows verified working.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py (677 lines) is approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules (auth.py, streams.py, ai.py, simulator.py) before adding more features.
JWT_SECRET in /app/backend/.env is a placeholder ('change-me-in-production-...'). Acceptable for MVP but flag for production hardening.

DCA simulator's series sampling formula `m % max(1, months // 60)` produces uneven point counts for small `years` (e.g., years=1 yields all 12 months; years=5 yields 60 points). Works but slightly non-uniform — consider always returning ~60 evenly-spaced samples.

Coach chat persists user message BEFORE LLM call; if LLM 502s, the user message is stored but no assistant reply — sessions list will show orphaned user-only turns. Consider transactional persist-after-reply or marking pending state.

Excellent: all endpoints use Pydantic validation, _id is excluded everywhere, all UUIDs are strings, all collections use user_id scoping, and frontend uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL via axios baseURL with Bearer interceptor.

success_rate.backend: 100% (26/26 when retried; 22/26 84.6% in single-pass due to EMERGENT_LLM_KEY budget cap)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 critical flows: landing, register, nav, streams CRUD, log-income, dashboard, simulator, goals, logout)

test_credentials: Created fresh users via /api/auth/register with pattern test+<timestamp>_<rand>@autopilot.io / TestPass123! Existing user demo@autopilot.io / demo123 was not used to keep tests isolated.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates one TEST_ user, one TEST_ stream ('TEST_Affiliate Blog' + 'TEST_UI Affiliate'), and 2-3 TEST_ entries. Stream is deleted via TestZCleanup. UI test users + remaining streams are not auto-deleted (no cascade-user delete endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. If AI tests fail with 502/'Budget has been exceeded', wait 30s and re-run the failing class in isolation (e.g., `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py::TestAICoach`). The EMERGENT_LLM_KEY can briefly throttle when 3 multi-thousand-token Claude calls fire within ~60s. All flows verified Jan 2026 against https://income-automation-21.preview.emergentagent.com.
rca_of_the_issue: AI test failures: root cause is transient budget exhaustion of the shared EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (litellm reports 'Max budget: 0.001' which appears to be a per-minute soft cap that resets quickly). Reproduced by running 3 AI endpoints sequentially; mitigated by spacing calls or running in isolation. No code change required.
